stretch.name: Stretch
stretch.tip: Stretch the image to fill the element

tile.name: Tile
tile.tip: Tile the image to fill the element

clip.name: Clip
clip.tip: Crop the image and stretch to fill the element

slice.name: Slice
slice.tip: Slice the image into 9 parts and tile to fill the element

uiButton-normalImage.label: Normal Image
uiButton-normalImage.tip: Image shown in button's normal state

uiButton-hoverImage.label: Hover Image
uiButton-hoverImage.tip: Image shown when button is hovered

uiButton-activeImage.label: Active Image
uiButton-activeImage.tip: Image shown when button is pressed

uiButton-flip.label: Flip
uiButton-flip.tip: How to flip the button image

both.name: Both
both.tip: Flip the image horizontally and vertically

uiButton-border.label: Border
uiButton-border.tip: Image sliced into 9 parts (4 corners, 4 edges, 1 center). Border size is corner side length

uiButton-imagePadding-box.label: Padding
uiButton-imagePadding-box.tip: Space between image and element border

uiButton-imageOpacity-box.label: Opacity
uiButton-imageOpacity-box.tip: Used to adjust the image's visibility

uiButton-imageEffect.label: Effect
uiButton-imageEffect.tip: Select the effect for the image

tint-1.name: Tint
tint-1.tip: Set the tint for the normal image, with the hover and active images inheriting the normal image's tint

tint-2.name: Tint (Normal, Hover)
tint-2.tip: Set separate tints for the normal and hover images, with the active image inheriting the hover image's tint

tint-3.name: Tint (Normal, Hover, Active)
tint-3.tip: Set separate tints for the normal, hover, and active images

uiButton-normalTint-box.label: Normal Tint
uiButton-normalTint-box.tip: Tint for button in normal state

uiButton-hoverTint-box.label: Hover Tint
uiButton-hoverTint-box.tip: Tint for button in hover state

uiButton-activeTint-box.label: Active Tint
uiButton-activeTint-box.tip: Tint for button in active state

horizontal-tb.name: Horizontal
horizontal-tb.tip: Content flows horizontally from left to right

vertical-lr.name: Vertical
vertical-lr.tip: Content flows vertically from top to bottom

uiButton-align-left.tip:
$Left
Align the left edge of the text with the left edge of the element

uiButton-align-center.tip:
$Center
Align the horizontal midpoint of the text with the horizontal midpoint of the element

uiButton-align-right.tip:
$Right
Align the right edge of the text with the right edge of the element

uiButton-align-top.tip:
$Top
Align the top edge of the text with the top edge of the element

uiButton-align-middle.tip:
$Middle
Align the vertical midpoint of the text with the vertical midpoint of the element

uiButton-align-bottom.tip:
$Bottom
Align the bottom edge of the text with the bottom edge of the element

uiButton-letterSpacing-box.label: Letter Spacing
uiButton-letterSpacing-box.tip: Spacing between each letter on the same line

uiButton-textPadding-box.label: Padding
uiButton-textPadding-box.tip: Space between text and element border

uiButton-font.label: Font
uiButton-font.tip: Enter the font name. If there are multiple fonts, separate them with commas in left-to-right priority order

shadow.name: Shadow
shadow.tip: Render text as shadow at the specified offset position

stroke.name: Stroke
stroke.tip: Render the specified width of the text outline, with half the width covered by the text

outline.name: Outline
outline.tip: Render the text as an outline by offsetting 1 pixel in each direction (top, bottom, left, right)

uiButton-textEffect-shadowOffsetX.label: Shadow X
uiButton-textEffect-shadowOffsetX.tip: Horizontal offset of the text shadow

uiButton-textEffect-shadowOffsetY.label: Shadow Y
uiButton-textEffect-shadowOffsetY.tip: Vertical offset of the text shadow

uiButton-textEffect-strokeWidth.label: Stroke Width
uiButton-textEffect-strokeWidth.tip: Width of the text outline stroke

uiButton-normalColor.label: Normal Color
uiButton-normalColor.tip: Text color in the button's normal state

uiButton-hoverColor.label: Hover Color
uiButton-hoverColor.tip: Text color in the button's hover state

uiButton-activeColor.label: Active Color
uiButton-activeColor.tip: Text color in the button's active state

uiButton-hoverSound.label: Hover SE
uiButton-hoverSound.tip: Sound effect when the button is hovered (must be manually triggered by the user)

uiButton-clickSound.label: Click SE
uiButton-clickSound.tip: Sound effect when the button is clicked
